content.title: Why Is GameStop (GME) Stock Rocketing Higher Today
content.summary: Shares of video game retailer GameStop (NYSE:GME) jumped 5.2% in the afternoon session after famed investor Michael Burry disclosed he had been buying its shares. Burry, known for his depiction in 'The Big Short,' revealed in a Substack post that he had been purchasing GameStop stock as a long-term value investment. This announcement fueled a rally that was already supported by strong insider confidence.

content.title: Michael Burry, an Early GameStop Buyer, Is Back Hyping the Stock
content.summary: In a post on Substack, Burry expressed his confidence in the company’s chairman and chief executive officer, Ryan Cohen, who has tried a number of strategies to confront the challenges facing GameStop’s network of physical stores as online gaming becomes more popular.  “I believe in Ryan, I like the setup, the governance, the strategy as I see it,” Burry wrote.

content.title: Here's How Hedge Funds Explore Prediction Markets For Investment Insights
content.summary: Hedge funds are beginning to utilize data from prediction markets to shape their investment strategies. Historically, hedge funds have been reluctant to engage with prediction markets due to the challenges associated with trading on platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket. These platforms often lack the depth necessary for larger bets on macro developments, and getting approval from compliance teams can be difficult.
